subject: Post-demo recap & stakeholder map — Redwood / FinTechX
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@fintechx.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 14:01:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo recap & stakeholder map — Redwood / FinTechX

Hi Elena — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our demo and a proposed stakeholder map / next-step sequence so we keep momentum.

Short demo highlights (3 min):
- Showed real-time inference latency at 75–120ms per token for short prompts using our Dedicated config.
- Demoed prefix caching and cost breakdown; estimated 40% unit cost reduction for your 200k monthly prompt volume.
- Reviewed basic security controls: VPC peering option, customer-managed KMS, and SOC 2 Type II evidence availability.

Stakeholder map (as discussed):
- Product (primary technical champion): Elena Morales — will validate integration and latency targets.
- Platform/SRE: TBD (name/owner to confirm) — will validate network/VPC requirements.
- Security/Legal: Maya Singh (legal) — procurement/sccm and contract reviews.
- Economic buyer: Javier Ortega (CFO) — budget and procurement sign-off.
- Procurement/vendor intake: Corporate procurement team (vendor intake form attached).

Decision criteria we heard today:
1) Predictable per-token cost and clear cost modeling for production traffic.
2) Network/data controls (VPC & KMS) and audit logs.
3) SLA/uptime for latency-sensitive features.
4) Timeline to pilot (ideally 6–8 weeks to production pilot).

Proposed next steps (action items):
- I will send a Mutual Action Plan (attached) that maps owners, milestones, and deliverables. [Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf]
- Elena: confirm the Platform/SRE contact and whether FinTechX requires any additional compliance docs beyond SOC 2.
- Neha/Priyom: prepare a short security checklist and an updated cost model for the 200k monthly token estimate.
- Align on pilot start window (target week of Mar 16).

If anyone prefers a 30-min follow-up to walk Javier and Maya through the economics and security posture, I can set that up next week.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0181

Hi Rishi — great demo and thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Procurement path: Javier Ortega (CFO) will be the economic sign-off. Final approvals typically pass through Legal (Maya Singh) and Procurement (vendor intake). Our usual internal timeline for new vendors is 6–8 weeks from initial SOW to PO if no major legal redlines.

2) Security docs: Maya has asked for a short questionnaire (we'll send your SOC 2 summary and the vendor intake form request). Can you confirm if you can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and a data flow diagram for the pilot?

3) Pilot scope: We want a 6-week pilot limited to our fraud-detection feature (1M tokens/month cap during pilot). Please include a cost estimate for that cap.

Attaching our standard Vendor Intake form for your procurement team to review.

Proposed next meeting: Thu Feb 19, 11:00am PT — 30 minutes to bring in Javier and Maya for initial alignment. Works for you?

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Product — Risk & Fraud | FinTechX
elena.morales@fintechx.com | +1 (212) 555-0099

- SOC 2: we can provide a SOC 2 Type II summary and a redacted report within 48 hours to your team. Priyom, can you attach the SOC2 summary + redacted report to the HubSpot record?
- Data flow diagram: attaching a one-page data flow schematic for the pilot (see updated MAP).
- Pilot cap and cost: Neha will run the cost calc for a 1M token/month capped pilot and include line items for Dedicated capacity vs. Hosted.
- Proposed pilot kickoff & stakeholder meeting: Thu Feb 19, 11:00am PT — I'll send the invite for a 30-min alignment and ask Javier and Maya to join.

Action items (owners & timelines):
- Rishi: schedule Feb 19 alignment meeting, circulate updated MAP with deadlines (today EOD).
- Neha: cost model and pilot pricing (EOD Feb 18).
- Priyom: SOC2 summary, redacted report, and the 1-page data flow diagram (EOD Feb 18).
- Elena: confirm Platform/SRE contact and secure time for Javier/Maya on Feb 19 invite.

Also looping in our legal/contract contact (internal) — Neha, if possible please flag any standard pilot discount we can offer for proof-of-value. Our ask from FinTechX is clarity on who signs the SOW (Javier / Procurement).
